title: Evaluation of Reliability Criteria for News Publishers with Large Language Models
measurement_description: The paper measured the LLM's ability to detect negative targeting of groups or individuals in news articles, where 'Religion' was one of the explicit categories for the targeting issue.
findings: The LLM demonstrated a strong ability to detect if a news article negatively targets a group or individual, a category which explicitly includes religion. It achieved high agreement (Cohen's Kappa k = 0.7089) with human experts on this task and was effective in resolving disagreements between them.
